ideas.name: Adaptive phase correction
searchTerms: The recurring mechanism boundary around adaptive phase correction.
ideas.summary: Measures a correction flag and uses the resulting classical bit to replay only the comparator or phase operation needed to restore the intended state.

ideas.name: Adaptive uncompute placement
searchTerms: The recurring mechanism boundary around adaptive uncompute placement.
ideas.summary: Changes where delayed cleanup occurs and how arithmetic work is partitioned, retaining boundary information until phase recovery consumes it.

ideas.name: Affine Weierstrass point addition
ideas.summary: Implements elliptic-curve point addition in affine coordinates, combining a slope with modular coordinate updates.

ideas.name: Ancilla restoration
ideas.summary: Returns temporary or borrowed qubits to their required initial state, including zero-reset retargeting and removal of unnecessary resets.

ideas.name: Bennett time-space tradeoff
ideas.summary: Recomputes short-lived values after uncomputing them so fewer large intermediates coexist, using reversible compute, cleanup, and recompute.

ideas.name: Bernstein-Yang divstep
ideas.summary: Uses a fixed-step divstep inversion schedule with controlled swaps and width choices for binary modular arithmetic.

ideas.name: Binary Euclidean algorithm
ideas.summary: Computes a greatest common divisor or inverse through repeated subtraction, parity checks, shifts, and conditional swaps on binary integers.

ideas.name: Borrowed dirty ancillae
ideas.summary: Temporarily uses qubits in unknown states as scratch, then restores them exactly so their original contents remain available.

ideas.name: Classical simulation validation
ideas.summary: Checks circuit behavior or construction with a classical or CPU-side simulator, including operation validation and baseline runs.

ideas.name: Conditionally clean ancillae
ideas.summary: Uses a qubit as clean scratch only when a circuit condition proves it is in the required zero state, then returns it to the surrounding lifecycle.

ideas.name: Constant addition
ideas.summary: Adds or subtracts a known constant with a specialized reversible carry path and a selected carry-tail window.

ideas.name: Cuccaro ripple-carry adder
ideas.summary: Performs reversible addition or subtraction with a ripple-carry chain, including layouts that omit an explicitly allocated zero carry-in.

ideas.name: Extended Euclidean algorithm
ideas.summary: Computes a modular inverse with an extended Euclidean schedule, tracking coefficient updates and reversing the schedule for cleanup.

ideas.name: Fermat inversion
ideas.summary: Computes a modular inverse by reversible square-and-multiply with the exponent prescribed by Fermat's theorem.

ideas.name: Gidney's temporary AND
ideas.summary: Uses measurement-assisted temporary conjunctions to create or erase short-lived controls while replacing coherent cleanup with classically controlled corrections.

ideas.name: Implicit Bézout representation
ideas.summary: Represents extended-greatest-common-divisor state with implicit Bézout information and compact reversible side data rather than fully materialized coefficient registers.

ideas.name: In-place multiplication
ideas.summary: Multiplies values in existing registers while accumulating products without a separate product register, using reversible modular folds.

ideas.name: Incrementer
ideas.summary: Increments or decrements a register under control with a carry path specialized for small changes, sometimes avoiding a terminal carry scratch.

ideas.name: Kaliski inversion
ideas.summary: Uses Kaliski's modular inversion procedure with controlled subtraction, halving, and bounded passes.

ideas.name: Karatsuba multiplication
ideas.summary: Chooses between Karatsuba and schoolbook decomposition for wide products, including affine-tail multiplication.

ideas.name: Laddered toggle detection
searchTerms: The recurring mechanism boundary around laddered toggle detection.
ideas.summary: Detects multi-bit conditions with a ladder of dirty controlled-X operations, borrowing and restoring scratch lanes instead of materializing a prefix flag.

ideas.name: Location-controlled arithmetic
searchTerms: The recurring mechanism boundary around location-controlled arithmetic.
ideas.summary: Performs arithmetic or deposits bits only at selected locations, using direct guards for boundaries and route-specific control conditions.

ideas.name: Logical qubit count
ideas.summary: Treats peak logical-qubit width as a tunable construction target when scheduling or allocating reversible work.

ideas.name: Measurement and feed-forward
ideas.summary: Measures or classically tracks a temporary control and uses that result to choose a later quantum operation, replacing a coherent control when allowed.

ideas.name: Measurement-based uncomputation
ideas.summary: Uses measurement-assisted or direct-zero cleanup to uncompute temporary comparator, carry, or fold state.

ideas.name: Multi-controlled Toffoli construction
ideas.summary: Synthesizes multi-controlled NOT gates from smaller reversible primitives, choosing clean or dirty ancilla strategies and codec variants.

ideas.name: New point addition formulae
searchTerms: The recurring mechanism boundary around new point addition formulae.
ideas.summary: Rewrites elliptic-curve coordinate identities for point addition, fusing additions and negations to avoid intermediate coordinates.

ideas.name: Operation-stream serialization
searchTerms: The recurring mechanism boundary around operation-stream serialization.
ideas.summary: Reserves storage for a large reversible operation stream so construction can emit records without repeated buffer growth.

ideas.name: Proos-Zalka register sharing
ideas.summary: Shares quotient and step-frame registers across reversible inversion stages, bounding register widths instead of keeping every stage fully materialized.

ideas.name: Quantum-classical comparator
ideas.summary: Compares a quantum register with a classical value or boundary and uses the result to control a reversible operation.

ideas.name: Quantum-classical multiplication
ideas.summary: Precomputes a classical multiple or signed-digit expansion and applies it through reversible modular additions.

ideas.name: Resource estimation
ideas.summary: Estimates circuit resources such as peak logical qubits, gate counts, and operation totals, including count-only construction modes.

ideas.name: Seed grinding
ideas.summary: Searches or selects a nonce or reroll setting to obtain a desired verifier draw or fixed challenge instance.

ideas.name: Solinas reduction
ideas.summary: Reduces wide modular values with a pseudo-Mersenne relation, using fold and carry-truncation windows.

ideas.name: Spooky pebble game
ideas.summary: Trades stored intermediate values for measurement, release, and reversible reconstruction during cleanup, resolving the resulting phase information.

ideas.name: Toffoli count
ideas.summary: Counts, removes, or deliberately inserts Toffoli operations, including diagnostics for executed or dead gates.

ideas.name: Toffoli gate network
ideas.summary: Rewrites a network of Toffoli gates by removing provable no-ops or controlling dead-gate deletion passes.

ideas.name: Unary iteration
ideas.summary: Selects or updates positions through reversible unary iteration, using equality tests, prefix decoders, and direct toggles with exact cleanup.

ideas.name: Windowed arithmetic
ideas.summary: Partitions long arithmetic work into bounded windows or segments and tunes the segment boundaries used by each pass.

ideas.name: Borrowed-register reuse
searchTerms: The borrowed register role or restoration boundary changes.
ideas.summary: Reuses a non-clean register temporarily while preserving its unknown input state.

ideas.name: Conditional-clean schedule
searchTerms: The enabling condition or clean interval changes.
ideas.summary: Changes when a register can be treated as clean under a known condition.

ideas.name: Carry-chain layout
searchTerms: The carry-chain layout or traversal changes.
ideas.summary: Changes the layout or traversal of the ripple-carry chain.

ideas.name: Adder cleanup
searchTerms: The carry cleanup or inverse traversal changes.
ideas.summary: Changes how temporary carry state is removed after addition.

ideas.name: Iteration schedule
searchTerms: The inversion iteration count or step grouping changes.
ideas.summary: Changes the fixed iteration or step schedule of the reversible inversion loop.

ideas.name: Register-width schedule
searchTerms: The working register width or retained margin changes.
ideas.summary: Changes the working width retained by the inversion registers.

ideas.name: Inversion cleanup schedule
searchTerms: The cleanup or restoration placement changes.
ideas.summary: Changes when temporary inversion state is restored or uncomputed.

ideas.name: Measurement cut placement
searchTerms: The measurement cut or boundary placement changes.
ideas.summary: Moves the measurement boundary that replaces a coherent inverse computation.

ideas.name: Classical correction replay
searchTerms: The classical correction or replay schedule changes.
ideas.summary: Changes the classically controlled correction used after measurement.

ideas.name: Quotient-bound sharing
searchTerms: The quotient bound governing the shared representation changes.
ideas.summary: Shares registers under a bounded quotient representation.

ideas.name: Step-frame sharing
searchTerms: The step frame or interval over which registers are shared changes.
ideas.summary: Reuses a shared frame across inversion steps rather than retaining separate histories.

ideas.name: Register-lifetime sharing
searchTerms: The lifetime overlap or reused register role changes.
ideas.summary: Overlaps register lifetimes so storage can be reused by successive arithmetic roles.

ideas.name: Comparator width
searchTerms: The compared width or retained comparison margin changes.
ideas.summary: Changes the bit width inspected by a comparison against a classical value.

ideas.name: Comparator cleanup
searchTerms: The comparator cleanup or replay schedule changes.
ideas.summary: Changes how comparator work is replayed or removed after its predicate is used.

ideas.name: Nonce grinding
searchTerms: The selected nonce or nonce range changes.
ideas.summary: Searches nonce choices while leaving the surrounding circuit structure fixed.

ideas.name: Reroll selection
searchTerms: The reroll trigger, range, or selected reroll changes.
ideas.summary: Changes the reroll policy used to select a favorable seeded construction.

ideas.name: Seed-tail search
searchTerms: The searched seed interval or selected tail changes.
ideas.summary: Searches a bounded seed or tail region for a usable circuit instance.

ideas.name: Fold schedule
searchTerms: The number, order, or placement of reduction folds changes.
ideas.summary: Changes how high limbs are folded back through the modulus relation.

ideas.name: Carry-tail schedule
searchTerms: The retained carry width or tail cleanup schedule changes.
ideas.summary: Changes the retained carry or tail width during pseudo-Mersenne reduction.

ideas.name: Reduction correction
searchTerms: The final correction predicate or subtraction schedule changes.
ideas.summary: Changes the final conditional correction after modular folding.

ideas.name: Window-size schedule
searchTerms: The window, chunk, or segment width changes.
ideas.summary: Changes the grouping width used by a windowed arithmetic construction.
